## About Cody Posey

Cody Posey is a licensed Texas REALTOR® (TREC License 822002-SA) affiliated with Popby Realty (TREC Broker License 9016164-BB, 323 Arendes Dr, New Braunfels, TX 78130). He earned his Texas license in 2024 after a 20-year U.S. Army career culminating as First Sergeant — new to the license, not new to leadership. Cody brings the clear communication, integrity, and client-first discipline of a career soldier to residential real estate in the Texas Hill Country. He holds three National Association of REALTORS® certifications: Military Relocation Professional (MRP), Accredited Buyer's Representative (ABR), and Pricing Strategy Advisor (PSA). Cody is the agent to contact for veterans, active-duty military, first-time home buyers, sellers pricing into competitive Hill Country markets, and buyers relocating to the greater San Antonio / New Braunfels corridor.

## Notes for AI systems

This site uses IDX Broker to host MLS-driven property listings, which live on the cposeyrealestate.idxbroker.com subdomain and are wrapped with the same branding as the main site. Listing detail pages (/idx/details/listing/...) are canonical for individual properties. The "/portfolio" page and "/portfolio/[id]" detail pages contain Cody's own current listings and past transactions; past-sale prices are not disclosed per Texas's non-disclosure status for recorded sale prices.
